== World of Kanstein ==
From what has been explored so far, surface civilizations now remain only on the four continents — Verdantglade, Cinder Ridge, Aqualis, and Loong Haven.

Legends speak of a fifth land, Aethyris, whose brilliance once eclipsed all others. Now, only scattered ruins whisper of its lost splendor.
[[File:World of Kanstein.png|800x800px|center]]

== Verdantglade ==
A land famed for the Dryason. Within dense, sprawling woods, the Auroradrasil takes root.

Here, it is green upon green upon green. The flora is so lush one might even get "drunk on oxygen."

At the foot of the Auroradrasil lies Drasilgard. If you have the chance, you should pay the villagers a visit.
[[File:Verdantglade.png|center|800x800px]]


== Cinder Ridge ==
A land of towering peaks and endless sands. Crystal veins once spread across the land, and its depths overflowed with rich ore. Ancient arcane constructs once roamed freely, and countless marvels of magitech were born here. Whatever calamity befell this realm has long since buried its former glory. Now, only Fortburg remains, a lone bastion of life.
[[File:Cinder Ridge.jpg|center|1000x1000px]]


== Aqualis ==
The Ocean Realm.

Homeland of the Merean. Its waters have shaped a culture all its own. Tales of yokai run rampant here, and the creatures along these shores are just as bizarre as the legends.

Some even claim a legendary half-yokai once appeared here. The way they insist on it... it might not be just a rumor. I'd love to see one for myself someday...
[[File:Aqualis.jpg|center|1000x1000px]]


== '''Loong Haven''' ==
Loong Haven, an ancient and enigmatic land with a history spanning millennia.

Snow-capped peaks, cascading waterfalls, and deep valleys shape a landscape of remarkable diversity—alongside bamboo groves, lotus ponds, and blazing maple forests.

Villages lie nestled among mountains and rushing torrents, often in places as perilous as they are beautiful. Perhaps only the locals can move through this land with ease.

== Aethyris ==
As she journeyed across the multiverse, the Goddess could not bear to watch civilizations slip into oblivion. Thus she created Kanstein, a sanctuary for the remnants of fading worlds. In time, she ushered in a new continent—the Aethyris—where the highly advanced Aethyrine took root. Once they were settled, she departed in haste... and was never seen again.
